reason: On my budget, spending ₹99 on a tiny 100g tube that empties in 4 parathas makes no sense, especially when packaged chutneys usually taste like preservatives.
objection: 100g is far too small a quantity for ₹99, and I suspect it will be full of artificial preservatives.
would_change_my_mind: A certified preservative-free recipe in a 250g pack priced under ₹60.
